reason: I'm not putting an unaudited startup with zero customers inline in front of customer trades and then explaining that vendor to my examiner. And caps, an approval queue and a kill switch are things my team can build in a quarter, which is exactly when we build rather than buy.
objection: No SOC 2 and no customers means it fails our vendor due diligence on day one. AINRA passports aren't a standard I've seen any regulator or peer firm ask about, so the identity piece looks like a bet on someone else's standard. And per-action pricing is hard to budget once agent traffic grows.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II plus a peer broker running it in production who an examiner has already looked at, with a flat annual price instead of per-action metering.
